# step2_memory.py
from pathlib import Path
from pydantic_ai import Agent
from common import make_model, show_context, watch

Path("memory.md").write_text("- The student's name is Sam.\n- Sam is taking CS357 and Calculus II.\n")

agent = Agent(make_model(), instructions="You are a concise study-planning assistant.", capabilities=[watch])

@agent.instructions
def long_term_memory() -> str:
    # Long-term memory is a file. Reading it here pastes it into the context.
    return "What you remember about this student:\n" + Path("memory.md").read_text()

first = agent.run_sync("Which two courses am I taking?")
print(first.output)
# Short-term memory: hand the earlier turns back in. Nothing is stored on the server.
second = agent.run_sync("Which of those has more programming?", message_history=first.all_messages())
print(second.output)
show_context()
description: Long-term memory from a file and short-term memory via message_history, both rendered as text in the context window.

steps.description: Memory implementation: file-based long-term and message_history short-term.
Setup: imports and memory.md creation with student info.
Agent creation: Agent with make_model and instructions.
Long-term memory: @agent.instructions decorator reads memory.md and pastes it into context.
First request: run_sync asks about courses, print output.
Short-term memory: second run_sync includes message_history from first to maintain conversation context.
Inspection: show_context reveals both memory types in the window.
